name: [HALLOWEEN UPD] speed demon boss fight (real)
desc:
!GAME CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS!

A game where you fight a very fast creature at first, but their defeat sparked a series of events.

• This is game is based on [FREE ADMIN], and therefore; a fan game, despite that, this game is not what it seems.
• Most fictional characters (Speed Demon, The Whigmaster, etc.) in this game was made and owned by the user: TheGreatMemelord111, while some other creations (Ahat Man and more) were made by the user: bizarre_ahat.
• Heavily inspired ULTRAKILL game.


NOTICE: Since this games focused on the usage of some general Roblox gears, this game was designed to be hard and is not for casual players (Roblox catalog gears requires experience to be able to use them properly; worth mentioning gear fighters). And if you were coming from SBSD to obtain Crossover rewards, don't expect this game to be so easy.
